summary.text: Jeremy Todd is the Libertarian Party nominee for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District. In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey he describes himself as a Christian and a Libertarian with a business career. He campaigns on reducing federal debt and money printing, ending overseas military commitments, and opposing government surveillance.

paragraphs.text: In his Ballotpedia survey, he says he was born and raised in the South, the son of a truck driver and a billing clerk.
He says he built a career in business, leading teams ranging from a handful of employees to organizations of more than 300 people. The survey does not name employers.
He describes himself as a husband and father who holds Christian and Libertarian views, favoring individual liberty, limited government and personal responsibility.
